outcomes.text: Give a basic definition of advertising and its role in communication and promotion.
Explain advertising objectives: awareness, changing attitudes, prompting action.
Identify the basic elements of an ad: message, visuals, target audience.
Restate a basic definition of advertising and its role.
Trace advertising's origins, early forms and its role in business and attitude formation.
Examine advertising in the 20th century: world wars, television, consumer culture.
Identify factors behind advertising's growth, such as information spread and propaganda.

units.title: Domain B: The Process of Communication

outcomes.text: List the basic elements of communication.
Explore differences between verbal, non-verbal and written communication.
Explain the role of language and tone in verbal communication.
Build storytelling and narration skills for advertising.
Practise oral communication in groups, such as problem-solving and decisions.
Identify non-verbal cues: body language, expressions, gestures, posture.
Apply non-verbal communication in presentations, discussions and casual talk.
Write well-structured messages for different purposes and audiences.
Write clear, concise messages for advertising.
Describe the AIDA and Hierarchy of Effects models.
Apply AIDA and Hierarchy of Effects to analyse how ads work.
Understand the DAGMAR model for setting measurable ad goals.
Demonstrate the DRIP model in advertising strategy.
Explore how differentiating, reminding, informing and persuading fit campaigns.
Explore the Ehrenberg model for designing campaigns.
Develop active listening to understand speech and improve interpersonal skills.

units.title: Domain C: Nature and Types of Advertising

outcomes.text: Understand types of advertising: print, digital, broadcast, outdoor.
Classify advertising types by features and medium.
Analyse each type's audience, message format and creative strategy.
Evaluate effectiveness through engagement, recall and consumer behaviour.
Compare strengths and weaknesses of ad types and their fit to products and audiences.

units.title: Domain D: Segmenting and Targeting the Audience

outcomes.text: Explain segmentation and its importance in marketing and advertising.
Explain how customers are segmented by needs, preferences, attitudes and behaviour.
Analyse geographic, demographic, psychographic and behavioural segmentation.
Decide when each segmentation type fits, such as geographic for shared local needs.
Evaluate the role and importance of targeting in advertising.
Compare targeting strategies such as online versus offline.
Discuss the nature and scope of digital marketing.
Discuss types: social media, email, search engine, referral and affiliate marketing.

units.title: Domain B: The Process of Communication

outcomes.text: Explain the Elaboration Likelihood Model and its central and peripheral routes.

Use advanced active listening to respond to verbal and non-verbal cues.
Apply negotiation and conflict resolution with clients and stakeholders.
Analyse how technology, including VR and AR, affects interpersonal communication.
Define the nature and purpose of persuasion.
List and explain Cialdini's six principles: reciprocity, consistency, liking, social proof, scarcity, authority.
Define creative writing in advertising and its role in strong ad copy.
Explain key elements of effective copy: clarity, creativity, audience engagement.
Write ad copy that communicates and resonates with the target audience.
Analyse storytelling techniques and narrative structures in ads.
Create ad content with narratives aligned to marketing objectives.
Evaluate how storytelling shapes brand messaging and consumer perception.
Learn core visual communication techniques in ad design.
Analyse how colour, typography and imagery convey messages.
Create simple ads using balance, contrast and hierarchy.
Explain when each type of digital marketing is suitable.
List advantages and disadvantages of each type.

Review the meaning and purpose of advertising and its principles.
Recall the definition, objectives and key elements of advertising.
Critically analyse strategies: audience identification, message positioning, media selection.
Give an overview of how advertising developed historically.
Restate the definition and objectives of advertising.
Identify key ad elements: messages, visuals, audience.
Analyse advertising strategies including targeting, positioning and media choice.
Trace advertising's progress through different eras.
Identify factors driving its evolution: printing press, TV, internet, AI.
Discuss the shift from traditional to digital advertising.
Describe the current state of advertising, including digital, the internet and AI.

units.title: Domain B: The Process of Communication

outcomes.text: Analyse speeches for rhetorical devices, persuasion and audience impact.
Develop oral presentation skills: clear speech, pace, engaging delivery.
Recognise and interpret non-verbal cues such as body language and facial expression.
Explore semiotics: signification, intertextuality and cultural codes in ads.
Analyse how signs and symbols work in cultural contexts and shape consumer views.
Explore cultural nuances in how advertising symbols are read.
Create symbolic content that fits complex marketing goals and audience preferences.
Master copywriting for social media, websites, blogs, print, broadcast and forums.
Craft compelling content that resonates with varied audiences and platforms.
Adapt writing style to the nuances of each platform.
Explain the Elaboration Likelihood Model and its central and peripheral routes.
Apply ELM to judge how effective persuasive messages are.
Explain basic semiotics: signs and symbols in advertising.
Identify how semiotics carries messages in ads.
Analyse ads for symbolic content and its effect on consumer perception.
Analyse how observational learning, imitation and modelling affect ad effectiveness.
Analyse cultural differences in language, non-verbal cues and customs.
Adapt messages to specific cultural contexts with sensitivity.

units.title: Domain C: Nature and Types of Advertising

outcomes.text: Analyse advanced types such as experiential, influencer and native advertising.
Assess strategic implications of different ad types for marketing goals.
Explore emerging trends: technology, social media, data analytics.
Examine ethical issues of ad types and their effect on diverse audiences.

units.title: Domain D: Segmenting and Targeting the Audience

outcomes.text: Evaluate how segmentation works on social media, search engines and websites.
Create customer segments on social platforms.
Evaluate the role and importance of targeting in advertising.
Compare targeting strategies such as online versus offline.

Design messages for transit and digital outdoor ads.
Evaluate the effectiveness of influencer marketing.

Develop strategies for positive relationships with community stakeholders.

Understand advertising's role within IMC.

units.title: Domain K: Role of AI in Advertising

topics.title: Standard K1: AI tools in advertising

outcomes.text: Explain how AI works and its basic functions in digital marketing.

Use AI tools such as ChatGPT, Canva and SemRush to create digital ads.
Create ad copy, scripts and content with ChatGPT.
Give a nuanced definition of public relations and its strategic importance.
Analyse the deeper history of public relations and its effect on advertising.
Analyse PR's role in brand reputation and consumer perception.
Develop integrated plans that include PR in advertising strategy.
Plan sophisticated events aligned with advertising and PR goals.
Master advanced PR content tailored to audiences and channels.
Develop advanced community engagement strategies for diverse stakeholders.
Use data analytics and indicators to measure PR impact.

units.title: Domain M: Ethical Issues in Advertising

outcomes.text: Explain ethics and privacy in digital media: data privacy, identity theft, phishing, intrusion.
Discuss data privacy in the age of AI and digital marketing.
Discuss discrimination: gender, racial, ethnic and others.
Discuss inclusion and related issues in the 21st century.
Discuss implications of diversity issues in advertising.
